In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the non-perturbative aspects of the N=4 supersymmetric gauge theory in four dimensions.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the gauge theory perturbation theory is in exact agreement, at all orders, with the string theory perturbation theory, in the large N limit, in a certain limit of the gauge coupling and in a certain limit on the string coupling.
the AdS/CCT correspondence provides a new, non-perturbative and exact approach to the computation of the anomalous dimension of the Konishi multiplet.

the string theory side of the Ad-S/CFT correspondence is in complete agreement with the gauge theory side for the anomalous dimensions of the Konishi and other operators in the planar limit of N=4 SYM.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the AdS/CCT correspondence is not a perturbative tool.
the AdS/CCT correspondence is an exact correspondence for all values of the gauge coupling.
the AdS/CF T correspondence provides a non-perturbative definition of N=4 gauge theories.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the gauge theory side of the correspondence is not just an exact duality, but is also an exact solution of a four dimensional gauge theory, and that the AdS string side is not only a non-perturbative definition of the theory, but also a non-pertubative solution.
the AdS/Cft correspondence provides us with a new and powerful tool to compute non-perturbative quantities of gauge theories, in particular the anomalous dimensions of gauge theory operators.

the integrable structure of the gauge theory is inherited by the string theory side of the correspondence, and that the integrability is preserved by the string worldsheet theory even when the string coupling is non-zero, which means that we can use integrable techniques to study the string side of AdS/CFT even in the non-perturbative regime of gauge theory.
